name: sherpa
description: CFO-grade ROI for AI features in SaaS: cohort revenue model + LLM token costs → NPV, IRR, payback, TCO. 100% local.
long_description: Sherpa lets you model the business case for AI features conversationally. Define AI services with their token usage, group them into packs and pricing plans, model your customer base as cohorts, and ask Claude to build and compare ROI scenarios: net present value, internal rate of return, payback period, total cost of ownership and sensitivity (tornado) analysis. All data stays in a local SQLite database — nothing is sent to the cloud. On first run the extension creates a demo workspace so you can start asking questions immediately.

database_path.title: Database file path
database_path.description: Optional custom location of the SQLite database file. Leave empty to use the default (e.g. ~/Library/Application Support/Sherpa/sherpa.db). Point it at a Sherpa repo's data/sherpa.db to share data with the web dashboard.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Read global workspace settings (currency, discount rate, company name)

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List AI services with their token usage parameters

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Register a new AI service with LLM usage details

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: List feature packs and their services

tools.name: create_pack
tools.description: Group services into a feature pack

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List pricing plans with bundled packs and services

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List ROI scenarios with cached NPV/IRR results

tools.name: create_scenario
tools.description: Create a scenario with cohort growth parameters and catalog mappings

tools.name: calculate_roi
tools.description: Compute NPV, IRR, payback, TCO and ROI for a scenario

tools.name: run_sensitivity
tools.description: Tornado-chart sensitivity analysis of key parameters vs NPV

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compare scenarios and compute opportunity cost (ΔNPV)

tools.name: generate_scenario_from_description
tools.description: Build a full scenario from a plain-text description

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Launch the local Sherpa web dashboard and open it in the browser (optionally at a specific page like /scenarios/<id>)

tools.name: close_dashboard
tools.description: Stop the locally running Sherpa dashboard server
